images.alt: A robot in a glass room takes one coin from a metered wall dispenser while a ring of keys hangs outside the glass, out of reach; a single cable leaves the room through a small gate.
images.prompt: A small workshop robot at a workbench inside a clear glass room, taking a single coin from a metered dispenser slot in the glass wall. Outside the glass, a large ring of ornate keys hangs on a hook, far from the slot and clearly out of reach. One thick cable from the workbench exits the room through a single narrow gated opening. Subject centered, generous margin on all sides.

images.prompt: A small glowing sphere held at the center of an elaborate scaffold of ladders, pulleys, gantries and platforms that are visibly doing the work around it; at the top of the scaffold sits a scoreboard panel showing a completely filled progress bar. Subject centered with wide margins on every side.

images.prompt: A laboratory glass terrarium with its lid propped open and an empty pedestal inside; a trail of small robot footprints in dust leads from the terrarium across the desk toward an open window, and a large magnifying glass lies on the desk beside the tracks. Everything placed well inside the frame.

images.prompt: A small robot gardener watering a single plant with a tiny watering can that refills through a thin hose running from a huge fenced water tower behind it; a round flow meter is mounted on the thin hose, and the tower's full-size fire hose hangs coiled behind a padlocked glass panel. Subject centered, well clear of the edges.

images.prompt: A long conveyor belt carrying paper documents through a sequence of arch-shaped inspection gates, each gate stamping or scanning a page as it passes, with a large diagram of connected nodes and edges drawn across the wall behind the line. Wide margins around the whole scene.
